title: Trim the WEB_CAREER_DISCOVERY lane once automatic intake is reliable?
detail: The source-trial Action already reads ~160 employer job boards every run. Grok's WEB_CAREER_DISCOVERY lane searches many of the same career sites. Once automatic intake (armed 2026-10-23) has run cleanly for a few days, the lane could be cut down to the priority companies the Action finds no board for (Tesla, Anduril, LeoLabs and others in the source-trial report).
blocks: Lower AI cost per run; nothing is blocked today.
recommended: Trim, but only after about a week of clean automatic intake runs.
action: Answer in chat; Claude records it in asks/resolved/.
